title: Paul McCartney live: Adopt-A-Minefield Gala, Los Angeles | 2002
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the second annual Adopt-A-Minefield Gala at the Century Plaza Hotel in Los Angeles, California, USA, on 18 September 2002.

McCartney performed at the charity’s gala event each year from 2001 to 2005.

Concert setlist

  • ‘Coming Up’
  • ‘Band On The Run’
  • ‘I Saw Her Standing There’
  • ‘Blackbird’
  • ‘We Can Work It Out’
  • ‘Michelle’
  • ‘Your Loving Flame’
  • ‘Let It Be’
  • ‘Hey Jude’

Adopt-A-Minefield Gala appearances

  • 14 June 2001: Beverly Wilshire, Los Angeles, USA
  • 18 September 2002: Century Plaza Hotel, Los Angeles, USA
  • 23 September 2003: Beverly Hilton, Los Angeles, USA
  • 15 October 2004: Century Plaza Hotel, Los Angeles, USA
  • 15 November 2005: Beverly Hilton, Los Angeles, USA
Page last updated: 7 March 2024

Also on this day...

  • 2024: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Chevalier Theatre, Medford
  • 2018: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Floyd L Maines Veterans Memorial Arena, Binghamton
  • 1993: Paul McCartney live: Westfalenhalle, Dortmund
  • 1991: Recording: Everybody Wins, Angel In Disguise by Ringo Starr
  • 1980: Recording: Every Man Has A Woman Who Loves Him, (Just Like) Starting Over, Give Me Something by John Lennon and Yoko Ono
  • 1980: Photography: John Lennon and Yoko Ono by Kishin Shinoyama
  • 1975: Wings live: Hammersmith Odeon, London
  • 1974: Recording: (It’s All Down To) Goodnight Vienna, No No Song by Ringo Starr
  • 1973: Paul McCartney collapses in Lagos
  • 1973: Editing, compiling: Mind Games by John Lennon
  • 1973: Ringo Starr buys Tittenhurst Park from John Lennon and Yoko Ono
  • 1972: Recording: Hi, Hi, Hi by Wings
  • 1969: Listening party: Abbey Road
  • 1969: Paul McCartney performs on Badfinger’s Rock Of All Ages
  • 1968: Recording, mixing: Birthday
  • 1968: George Harrison is interviewed for New Musical Express and BBC
  • 1967: Filming: Magical Mystery Tour
  • 1966: John Lennon travels to Carboneras, Spain
  • 1964: The Beatles live: Memorial Auditorium, Dallas
  • 1960: The Beatles live: Indra Club, Hamburg
